description: Figure 5, titled “Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments,” is a grouped bar chart comparing the average entropy values of three sycophancy reduction methods — Baseline (pink), Source Info (yellow), and Direct Command (light blue) — across three different AI models: GPT-4, Claude, and Llama. The vertical axis, labeled “Entropy Average Values,” ranges from 3.0 to 6.0 with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. For each model, the three bars are grouped side by side. In all three model groups, the Source Info method consistently shows the highest entropy (approximately 5.2 for GPT-4, 5.1 for Claude, and 4.9 for Llama), followed by Direct Command (approximately 5.0 for GPT-4, 4.9 for Claude, and 4.8 for Llama), and then Baseline (approximately 4.9 for GPT-4, 4.7 for Claude, and 4.6 for Llama). The chart visually supports the textual claim that Source Info introduces the most variation (highest entropy), while Baseline produces the least.
